title: Rapid mlx: pypdf has possible large memory usage for exceptions in strict mode (CVE-2026-119207)
description: CVE-2026-119207 is a high-severity vulnerability in pypdf that allows an attacker to craft a malicious PDF causing large memory usage when an invalid dictionary is loaded in strict mode. This can lead to resource exhaustion. The issue has been fixed in pypdf version 6.21.3. Users unable to upgrade immediately can apply the changes from the referenced pull request as a workaround.
